A.claim: The bases of any Beal counterexample are pairwise coprime (gcd A B = gcd A C = gcd B C = 1), and no counterexample has A = B.

B.claim: Beal is FALSE over the Gaussian integers: (-2+i)^3 + (-2-i)^3 = (1+i)^4, with exponents (3,3,4) all >= 3 and bases sharing no Gaussian prime (norms 5, 5, 2). Therefore Beal cannot be proved from unique factorisation alone; any valid proof must use the total ordering of Z or the ramification of rational primes.
